title: Trading Before a Committed Rebalance
abstract: arXiv:2611.25762v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An institution must complete a portfolio adjustment, but traders who prepare inventory for it can choose whether to participate. We study how public forecasts affect the institution's cost in a Bayesian execution game with optional activation, transient impact, and uniform-price terminal completion. The curvature of equilibrium cost as a function of the posterior target mean determines the value of information. In the scalar model, information benefits every fixed participation roster. Optional supply can reverse this ranking at entry, at full participation, and in a smooth interior with lognormal activation costs. For centered scalar targets, information weakly lowers cost relative to no information, strictly when the posterior mean is nonzero with positive probability. translated_abstract: 一个机构必须完成组合调整，但为其准备存货的交易者可以选择是否参与。我们在一个具有可选激活、瞬时冲击和统一价格终端完成的贝叶斯执行博弈中，研究公开预测如何影响机构的成本。均衡成本作为后验目标均值的函数的曲率决定了信息的价值。在标量模型中，信息使每一个固定的参与名单受益。而可选供给可以在进入时、完全参与时以及在对数正态激活成本下的平滑内部区间中反转这一排序。对于中心化的标量目标，相对于无信息情形，信息弱性地降低成本，且当后验均值以正概率非零时严格降低。中心化高斯精度提升总是有益的。一个精确的对称有限总体均衡刻画了信息分辨率与个体策略行为之间的相互关系。
tldr: 本文在带可选参与和瞬时冲击的贝叶斯执行博弈中研究公开预测对机构再平衡成本的影响，发现信息的价值由均衡成本对后验目标均值的曲率决定，可选供给可能反转信息带来的收益排序，而中心化高斯精度提升总是有益的。
en_tdlr: This paper studies how public forecasts affect an institution's rebalancing cost in a Bayesian execution game with optional participation and transient impact, showing that the value of information is determined by the curvature of equilibrium cost as a function of the posterior target mean, optional supply can reverse the benefit ranking of information, while centered Gaussian precision gains are always beneficial.
